title: Add prescriber details to Patient Registry and refresh drug dataset + verification

requirements.text: In the Patient Registry workflow, provide a Prescriber Details section for the selected patient with fields: Prefix (dropdown), Full Name, Registration Number, Address, Mail ID (email), Contact Number, and Specialization, and ensure it is reachable from the Patient Registry tab without leaving the patient context.

quotes: In patient registry tab add prescribers details like prefix dropdown section add Dr., practicioner nurse, pharmacist, then registration number, address, mail id, contact number, specilization

acceptanceCriteria: From the Patient Registry area, when a patient is selected, there is a visible way to open/view the Prescriber Details form for that patient.
The Prescriber Details form contains the requested fields and uses English labels (e.g., "Mail ID", "Registration Number", "Specialization").
Prefix is a dropdown with exactly these user-facing options: "Dr.", "Practitioner Nurse", "Pharmacist".

requirements.text: Update the Prescriber prefix dropdown labeling so the user-facing value for PrescriberPrefix.practitionerNurse is "Practitioner Nurse" (not "Nurse"), and ensure all user-facing text is correctly spelled and consistent across the Prescriber Details UI and Case Summary.

quotes: add prescribers details like prefix dropdown section add Dr., practicioner nurse, pharmacist

acceptanceCriteria: The Prescriber Details prefix dropdown shows "Dr.", "Practitioner Nurse", and "Pharmacist" as the selectable labels.
Anywhere the prefix is displayed (including the case summary view), the label "Practitioner Nurse" is used (and not shortened to "Nurse").

requirements.text: Implement backend support for saving and retrieving prescriber details per patient, including: (1) a query method to get prescriber details by patientId, and (2) an update method to save/replace prescriber details for a patientId, performing validation consistent with backend validation rules.

quotes: add prescribers details ... then registration number, address, mail id, contact number, specilization

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query to retrieve prescriber details for a given patientId and returns an optional result (no trap when missing).
Backend exposes an update call to save prescriber details for a given patientId and rejects invalid input with a clear error response (e.g., missing required fields).
Prescriber details are stored and returned with all fields: prefix, fullName, registrationNumber, specialization, contactNumber, email, address.
Frontend PrescriberDetailsSection successfully loads existing saved details (if present) and can save updates without console errors.

requirements.text: Persist prescriber details across canister upgrades by adding stable storage for the prescriber details map keyed by patientId, and add a conditional migration if required by the existing state layout.

quotes: please check everything, In patient registry tab add prescribers details ...

acceptanceCriteria: After saving prescriber details for a patient, performing a simulated upgrade (local) retains prescriber details for that patientId.
No existing patient/lab/medication/ADR data becomes inaccessible after the change.

requirements.text: Review and update the drug dataset so the complete drug list is up to date and includes missing entries as needed, ensuring every drug record includes at minimum: name, status (approved/banned), date, category (when known), description, source, and safetyInfo.

quotes: check and add all the drug details and if you feel any thing require then please add them so it becomes fully up to date.

acceptanceCriteria: The curated dataset used by the app is updated/expanded, and each entry conforms to the minimum required fields: name, status, date, category, description, source, safetyInfo.

Drug details views (e.g., the drug details modal) have no missing/undefined values for the above minimum fields; if a field is unknown, it is represented as an explicit, user-friendly placeholder in English (e.g., "Unknown").

requirements.text: Add/ensure a post-refresh drug verification workflow exists that checks that drug list additions/updates were applied correctly (e.g., deduplication, required-field completeness, counts), and expose the latest verification result to the UI.

quotes: check and add all the drug details ... fully up to date.

acceptanceCriteria: There is a backend-accessible or frontend-driven verification step that runs after a drug list refresh/update and produces a structured verification result including a timestamp.
The UI shows the latest verification timestamp and a clear pass/fail or warnings summary (English) that helps confirm the list is fully loaded and consistent.
Verification includes at least: total drug count, count by status (approved/banned), and detection of duplicate normalized names.

requirements.text: Perform an application review focused on Patient Registry + Drug Database screens and fix any issues that prevent the full datasets (patients/drugs) from loading and being usable (e.g., missing queries, partial rendering, broken filters/pagination), without introducing unrelated features.
acceptanceCriteria: Patient Registry patient list loads reliably and selecting a patient consistently loads associated modules (labs/medications/ADR/prescriber/summary).
Drug Database tabs (All/Approved/Banned) reliably render the full corresponding dataset and search/category filters apply to the full list (not a partially loaded subset).
No runtime errors in console during common flows: select patient, open prescriber tab, save prescriber details, open drug database, open drug details modal.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if required for stable-state upgrades.
Do not edit any frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Integrating external drug databases or live third-party APIs for real-time drug updates.
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
